angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,064,421 km at 253.31 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.9477 +/- 0.0224 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 253.31 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.53 +/- 0.14 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-34 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract): 1,064,421 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.392 +/- 0.047 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-34 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6442 +/- 88 K from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-34 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-34 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-34.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.212, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 351766: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-34 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.22 dex, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-34 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.6003, from Mallonn et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...622A..81M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-34 (pscomppars): age 1.7 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-34 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 24 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
